<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="notes"><nowiki>Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088589627505.png?v=1" alt="eq4" title="eq4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used over </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087809617931.png?v=1" alt="biting4" title="biting4" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Loading into Fort Forinthry is very intensive, potentially losing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1" alt="dba" title="dba" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> time. The following reduces load times:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Reducing draw distance to Low</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Turning off textures</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1" alt="amhej" title="amhej" kind="icon" /><nowiki> actually does matter for a lot of damage. It's imperative to treat </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1" alt="dragonclaw" title="dragonclaw" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as a switch, not </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1" alt="amhej" title="amhej" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as a switch.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you end up using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when Zemouregal has around 70k HP left, move </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1" alt="gmaul" title="gmaul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> up and use it with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to instantly KO Zemouregal. Alternatively, if you get an early </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofful" title="scriptureofful" kind="icon" /><nowiki> proc and 3+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1219291285358120990.png?v=1" alt="primordialice" title="primordialice" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1" alt="lengmh" title="lengmh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, you can replace </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879439069184.png?v=1" alt="punish" title="punish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and two </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1" alt="gmaul" title="gmaul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>
